propositions: reconcile_check.py performs vendor-shape comparisons using direct adapter sibling loads (outbound_fields.py, adf.py) instead of canonical backend mapper machinery
assignee comparison uses string-to-dict matching via _assignee_matches instead of canonical assignee_identity matching with InboundMapper
description normalization uses adf.fit_text_to_adf_limit directly instead of flowing through the mapper's ADF-fit path and _text_matches comparison
status/priority field extraction uses raw dict unwrap instead of canonical mapping through InboundMapper.map_remote_to_local
reconcile_check lacks a neutrality gate preventing adapters.jira imports and by-path loads of vendor siblings like adapters/jira/outbound_fields.py
annotation-label-driven status precedence is not applied during reconcile-check comparison, causing discrepancies in tickets with rebar-status:blocked or rebar-status:cancelled labels
